title: TRANSPORTER MULTI
tagline: Enhanced CCIP Transporter App allowing aggregation of the assets
description:
1. Description
The CCIP Chainlink project aims to enhance Chainlink's Transporter app, which facilitates token transfers between EVM-compatible chains. Our upgraded version introduces multi-chain asset aggregation and automated actions on the destination chain, streamlining cross-chain transactions and expanding utility for users.
2. Core Concept
The core concept revolves around simplifying and expanding cross-chain asset management. Users can now consolidate assets from multiple chains to meet their target amount on a destination chain, all in one transaction. Additionally, the enhanced app allows users to predefine actions for their transferred assets, automating processes like staking or purchasing NFTs upon arrival.
3. Key Features

Multi-chain asset aggregation for single-click transfers
Dropdown menu for selecting destination chain actions:

Direct wallet reception
Transfer to another wallet
Stake with Rocket Pool
Mint stablecoins backed by rETH
Purchase NFTs


Seamless integration with existing Chainlink infrastructure
User-friendly interface for complex cross-chain operations

4. Example and Use Case
Scenario: A user needs 1000 USDC on Chain X for a DeFi opportunity.
Current assets:

500 USDC on Chain Y
500 USDC on Chain Z

Using our enhanced Transporter app:

User selects Chain X as the destination
Specifies 1000 USDC as the target amount
App automatically identifies and aggregates funds from Chains Y and Z
User chooses to stake the funds with Rocket Pool upon arrival
With one click, the app executes the multi-chain transfer and staking action

This streamlined process saves time, reduces complexity, and minimizes the risk of missing opportunities due to fragmented liquidity.
how_its_made:
5. How It's Made - Tech Stack
Our enhanced Transporter app leverages cutting-edge technologies:

Frontend:

Next.js 15: For a responsive and efficient user interface
Thirdweb: To simplify blockchain interactions and wallet connections


Smart Contracts:

Solidity: For writing secure and gas-efficient smart contracts


Backend Integration:

Chainlink's CCIP (Cross-Chain Interoperability Protocol): Enables secure cross-chain communications and transactions
